crossRefs.note: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and…
Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;
and behold, joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: “Let’s eat and drink…
Those who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

translations.web: I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”
translations.bsb: I said of laughter, “It is folly,” and of pleasure, “What does it accomplish?”
translations.kjv: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth
translations.asv: I said of laughter, It is mad; and of mirth, What doeth it?
